ns2:section.sectionText: For more information, visit https://publish.illinois.edu/nutrition-fshn120/consider120/. If you have any questions about the course or its structure, feel free to e-mail the lead instructor (Toni Burkhalter) at Burkhalt@Illinois.edu and she will get back to you by the close of the next business day. If you would like to add the course but you get a 'course full' error message, go to www.fshn.illinois.edu and click on Undergraduate then Course Wait List. Wait lists will not open until one week before classes start in August. Until that time, please continue to check the status of this course to see if a seat has become available for you.
